transitions: 0.2-second fades through the gallery background at scene boundaries

coverLoop.method: Native released-app Three.js meshes and materials. Real render frames 1–175 play forward then backward, returning to the same assembled pose. The initial recorder setup frame is excluded. No optical-flow interpolation.
coverLoop.captureMotion: 6-second source; explodedAmount = 0.8 * (1 - cos(2*pi*t)) / 2; camera azimuth = -76 + 14*sin(2*pi*t) degrees; elevation = 49 + 3*sin(2*pi*t) degrees
coverLoop.composition: Native software geometry, background-margin crops and typography overlays; no retouched terrain.
